test_title: PYST 24: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 19 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: XTXY is related to CYCD in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, GCGH is related to LHLM. To which of the given options is LHLM related, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0270f2b5240d1e3915517248ac98d6d73ad611166857551401277421991a6c6e.png] 

The logic followed here is:

The pattern established is: (First Word) + 5 → (Second Word).

For, XTXY is related to CYCD 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d3128ea06813f068983d83ee6776c4f3865ffba9ce7ef4f46280f08b0862c3e4.png] 

For, GCGH is related to LHLM

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/75e1061702b65d74768e9a04d9a548a040a347387e8f1a77719f8547e4e14558.png] 

Similarly, for** LHLM **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/971cd9660f44806b4bab61a2eacc8e33be6c4270f931ab17e363d5c092463445.png] 

So, LHLM will be written as **QMQR**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
